part1.prompt: O que significa “take care of” nesta frase?
part1.context: I take care of my younger brother after school.
part1.explanation: Take care of significa cuidar de alguém ou de alguma coisa.

part1.expected: She has never tried this before.
part1.explanation: O Present Perfect com she é formado por has + particípio passado.

part1.prompt: Qual é a correção completa desta frase?
part1.context: He don't went to work because he was sick.

options.text: He doesn't went to work because he was sick.
He didn't go to work because he was sick.
He not go to work because he was sick.
He wasn't go to work because he was sick.

part1.expected: He didn't go to work because he was sick.
part1.explanation: No passado negativo usamos didn't + verbo na forma base: go.
